subject: Next steps — procurement path & trial-to-paid handoff (Talos AI)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@talos.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — procurement path & trial-to-paid handoff (Talos AI)

Hi Rita — thanks again for the demo and the productive conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the trial running and align procurement expectations: 

Recap (from today)
- You’ll run a 4-week pilot against your search reranking workload with 3 test services and ~200k generated tokens/week.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 95th pct latency under 250ms end-to-end, embedding similarity recall >= 0.88 on eval set, and stable cost per 1k tokens below the threshold you shared.

Open questions / asks from our side
1) Procurement route: do you plan to pay by corporate card, issue a PO to Redwood, or transact through the Talos marketplace listing? Please confirm preferred path and any internal PO template or required fields.
2) Billing start: do you want billing to begin the day the pilot ends (and is accepted), or start on a fixed date irrespective of the pilot acceptance? We usually recommend billing after a short customer acceptance window (3 business days) so you can confirm success criteria.
3) Procurement contact: please share the procurement lead (name + email) so we can send the PO and any required paperwork.
4) Marketplace: if you’re interested in marketplace procurement, we’ll need legal/finance details for setup; let us know and we’ll loop in Partnerships.

What I’m attaching: a blank PO template (Talos_Multi-year_PO_Template.docx) and an initial draft SOW we can tailor. I’ll also prepare a simple mutual action plan once you confirm procurement path.

Proposed near-term plan
- By 7/9: confirm procurement route & contact (Talos)
- By 7/12: Redwood to send PO paperwork or DocuSign link + tailored SOW
- 7/13–8/9: pilot runs (4 weeks)
- Billing starts: TBD (we recommend acceptance-based start)

If it helps, we can accept a signed PO (Net 30 invoicing) or charged card for immediate access — both work. You’ve got me and Marissa on copy; Marissa will confirm commercial terms (discounts/SLA) if needed.

Thanks — I’ll stand by to send the paperwork as soon as you confirm the procurement path.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: Talos_Multi-year_PO_Template.docx]
[Attachment: SOW-draft-v1.pdf]

Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps — procurement path & trial-to-paid handoff (Talos AI)

Thanks Vivek — good notes. Quick answers from my side: 

- Procurement route: we prefer a PO for this engagement. We are *also* evaluating the marketplace route (Talos cloud marketplace) for the longer term, but PO for now.
- Procurement contact: procurement@talos.ai (I've CC'd them here).
- Billing start: we prefer billing to start the Monday after pilot acceptance. That gives our PMs 2 business days to validate.

A couple of asks:
1) Do you support invoicing to our parent company (Talos Holdings)? We’ll confirm legal name once procurement does a quick check.
2) Any standard discount for multi-year/committed usage? Please have someone from your team confirm.

I’m attaching our internal procurement timeline spreadsheet. Procurement will reach out with a PO number once they have the approvals.

Rita
Rita Gomez
Head of Product Operations
Talos AI
rita.gomez@talos.ai

[Attachment: Talos-Procurement-Timeline.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@talos.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — procurement path & trial-to-paid handoff (Talos AI)

Thanks Rita — looping in a quick commercial note so expectations are clear. Vivek / Aisha: please treat this as the working guidance for the SOW/quote.

Commercial guidance (internal)
- Discounting: Talos is eligible for our standard 10% launch discount for first-year committed spend (requires a minimum 12 month commitment). If they opt for a single pilot + month-to-month after, discounting is limited.
- Invoicing: Redwood supports invoicing to a parent company legal entity; procurement should provide legal name + remit info and we’ll generate the invoice (Net 30).
- Marketplace: if Talos later transitions to procurement via marketplace, billing will flow through the marketplace partner and terms may differ (we’ll coordinate). Marketplace setup typically takes 4–6 weeks — do not use as the primary path if Talos needs immediate access.

Action items for Redwood (assigned)
- Vivek: prepare a PO-ready DocuSign envelope with the SOW attached and terms (due 7/9).
- Aisha: include an explicit billing-start clause that defaults to "billing begins after customer acceptance (3 business days) unless a fixed date is provided".
- Marissa (me): confirm discount and SLA language for the draft SOW; will provide approval on the quote.

I’ll review the SOW-draft-v1 and return with redlines by 7/9 morning. Vivek, once procurement provides the legal remit, I’ll route the invoice template.

-Marissa
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
